title: Scrabble
statementMd:
Enrique and Yan frequently play a game called 1D Scrabble. The game is played on a one-dimensional, infinite board using a fixed dictionary of unique words. On the first turn ($i = 1$), any word $w_1$ from the dictionary may be played. On every subsequent turn ($i  \gt  1$), the played word $w_i$ must contain the previous word $w_{i-1}$ as a contiguous substring. The game concludes as soon as no valid moves remain.

Recently, Yan did not have time to play, so Enrique started playing with GePeTo. However, GePeTo started hallucinating! It consistently states that this game is trivial, arguing that there are very few combinations. Help Enrique convince GePeTo by calculating the total number of distinct possible games. Two games are distinct if their sequences of played words $(w_1, \ldots, w_k)$ are different.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $N$ ($1 \leq N \leq 10^5$), the number of words.

Each of the next $N$ lines contains a word $w$ consisting of lowercase English letters. It is guaranteed that all words are unique and the sum of lengths of all words does not exceed $10^5$.

## Output

Print a single integer: the number of distinct possible games modulo $10^9+7$.
statementZhMd:
Enrique 和 Yan 经常玩一种名为一维拼字游戏的游戏。游戏使用一个由互不相同的单词组成的固定词典，在一块一维无限长的棋盘上进行。在第一回合（$i = 1$），可以放置词典中的任意单词 $w_1$。在之后的每一回合（$i  \gt  1$），放置的单词 $w_i$ 必须包含上一个单词 $w_{i-1}$ 作为连续子串。当没有合法操作时，游戏立即结束。

最近，Yan 没有时间玩游戏，于是 Enrique 开始和 GePeTo 一起玩。然而，GePeTo 开始产生幻觉了！它一直声称这个游戏很简单，理由是可能的组合非常少。请计算不同的可能游戏过程的总数，帮助 Enrique 说服 GePeTo。如果两局游戏中放置的单词序列 $(w_1, \ldots, w_k)$ 不同，就认为它们是不同的游戏过程。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $N$（$1 \leq N \leq 10^5$），表示单词的数量。

接下来的 $N$ 行，每行包含一个由小写英文字母组成的单词 $w$。保证所有单词互不相同，且所有单词的长度之和不超过 $10^5$。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数：不同的可能游戏过程的数量对 $10^9+7$ 取模后的结果。
